title: Old screw-fuse panel

mitigation.action: Electrician inspects the main panel and replaces it with automatic fuses and a residual-current device

known_quirks: Loose screw-fuse holders overheat and char the panel base
Panels from before 1985 usually have no residual-current device
why_hint: DRAFT: The house is from before 1985 and the panel still has screw fuses, or nobody has confirmed the panel type. Panels of this age overheat at loose fuse holders.
benefit_hint: DRAFT: An electrician's check removes the most common cause of electrical fires in houses of this age.
